subject: PO header / ledger cutover + early-payment discount options
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martin <elena.martin@glyphhealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, Apr 18, 2028 at 09:12 AM -07:00
Subject: PO header / ledger cutover + early-payment discount options

Hi Elena,

Great to connect yesterday. As we move toward procurement onboarding for GlyphHealth, a couple of finance/process items came up that we want to lock down before the ledger cutover on May 1. Can you confirm the following on your side?

1) PO structure: do you require a unique PO per legal entity and per billing period (i.e., one PO per month), or will a single blanket PO with line-item metadata (BU/GL codes) work? If you need one PO per billing period, we need to know the required header fields and exact formatting (sample preferred).

2) Net terms & early-payment discounts: Glyph standard terms are fine — we just want to understand if you have an existing early-pay program (e.g., 0.5% @ net30 or 1% @ net15). We can be flexible on offering an early-pay discount in exchange for an accelerated invoice cadence.

3) Invoice cadence: would you prefer consolidated monthly statements vs weekly stubs for internal cost centers? Our platform supports both, but mapping to your ERP will require stable PO IDs or a BU_ID field in the invoice.

I attached our Redwood PO format guideline to show the fields we can populate. If you prefer, we can also provide a sample invoice (with obfuscated numbers) that shows how BU and GL fields map back to your PO.

Next steps: if you can send your PO template and confirm the discount options you’d consider, we’ll draft a short procurement appendix to incorporate the agreed fields and the early-payment discount schedule.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

Attachment: Redwood_PO_Format_Guidelines.pdf

From: Elena Martin <elena.martin@glyphhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Samuel Park <samuel.park@glyphhealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@glyphhealth.com>
Date: Wed, Apr 18, 2028 at 11:08 AM -07:00
Subject: Re: PO header / ledger cutover + early-payment discount options

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for the clear note. Quick answers below and I attached our PO template for reference.

- PO structure: We require a PO per legal entity. We can accept a blanket PO for a program, but for invoicing we require the PO number + the following header fields on every invoice: ENTITY_ID, BU_CODE, GL_ACCOUNT, PO_NUMBER. If those fields are present we will accept consolidated monthly invoices tied back to a single PO number (we make internal allocations).

- Net terms & discounts: Our standard is net60. Procurement can approve early-pay discounts but only via our Early Payment Program (EPP). Typical EPP offers: 1.5% if paid within 15 days, 0.75% if paid within 30 days — discounts are evaluated per-vendor during onboarding. Can you confirm whether Redwood prefers a fixed schedule we propose or we evaluate on net-new vendors?

- Invoice cadence: Consolidated monthly invoice is preferred. We can accept weekly stubs for large programs, but those stubs must reference the same PO and include BU_CODE for auto-allocation.

We also need vendor W9 and our vendor setup form completed (banking details + remittance instructions).

Attaching: GlyphHealth_PO_Template.docx

Elena Martin
Director, Vendor Operations
GlyphHealth
elena.martin@glyphhealth.com
+1 212-555-2211

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, Apr 19, 2028 at 08:35 AM -07:00
Subject: RE: PO header / ledger cutover + early-payment discount options

Vanessa / team —

Looping internal finance ops and procurement on what Glyph provided. Quick thoughts on constraints from our side:

- Ledger cutover: May 1 is tight but doable if PO header and BU mapping are finalized by Apr 25. After cutover, changing mapping fields will require a manual journal — we should avoid that.

- PO idempotency: We need Glyph to guarantee stable PO_NUMBER semantics (no re-issuance for the same period) or include a version field. Our ingestion pipeline deduplicates on PO_NUMBER + ENTITY_ID + ISSUE_DATE. If Glyph re-uses numbers, mapping breaks.

- Discount mechanics: We can offer the following, contingent on bank transfer (ACH) and vendor setup completed: 1.0% discount if paid within 15 days (net15), 0.5% if paid within 30 days (net30). This is our standard for enterprise customers when we can centralize payments. The 1.5% @15 you quoted is high for our margins but we can consider a pilot if Glyph commits to accelerated payment and consolidated monthly invoice.

- Required fields: ENTITY_ID, BU_CODE, GL_ACCOUNT are fine. We also need PAYEE_TAX_ID on the PO or the vendor setup form for tax mapping.

I attached a proposed tiered discount sheet to formalize the options. Once Vanessa confirms the final preferred cadence, I’ll draft the appendix language for procurement and finance.

-Vivek
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Proposed_Tiered_Discount_Schedule.xlsx

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martin <elena.martin@glyphhealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, Apr 20, 2028 at 10:22 AM -07:00
Subject: Re: PO header / ledger cutover + early-payment discount options

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the template and the clarity. Summarizing our proposal so we have a single place of truth:

Proposal (for GlyphHealth procurement approval)
- PO requirement: one PO per legal entity is acceptable. Glyph to include ENTITY_ID, BU_CODE, GL_ACCOUNT and PO_NUMBER on every invoice.
- Invoice cadence: Redwood prefers consolidated monthly invoices with the ability to also send weekly stubs on request. Each stub will include BU_CODE for your allocation.
- Net terms & discount: Redwood can offer 1.0% off gross invoice if paid within 15 days (net15) and 0.5% if paid within 30 days (net30). These discounts require vendor banking details (ACH) and completed W9/vendor setup. If Glyph requires the 1.5% @15 EPP, please flag for procurement escalation — we will evaluate but need to run margin impact analysis.
- PO idempotency: Glyph to confirm PO_NUMBER stability (no re-use) or include PO_VERSION to prevent ingestion collisions.

Next items from Redwood:
- I will send a sample obfuscated invoice by end of day Monday showing field placement for ENTITY_ID / BU_CODE / GL_ACCOUNT.
- Ben will prepare the short procurement appendix language for your review (1 page).

If this looks good, can you confirm by Monday (Apr 23) so we can finalize vendor setup and make the May 1 ledger cutover?

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_PO_Format_Guidelines.pdf (earlier), Proposed_Tiered_Discount_Schedule.xlsx (internal)

From: Elena Martin <elena.martin@glyphhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Samuel Park <samuel.park@glyphhealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@glyphhealth.com>
Date: Sun, Apr 21, 2028 at 03:45 PM -07:00
Subject: Re: PO header / ledger cutover + early-payment discount options

Vanessa / team —

Thanks. Procurement confirms the following:
- We will include ENTITY_ID, BU_CODE, GL_ACCOUNT and PO_NUMBER on invoices. We will not re-issue PO numbers for the same period; if changes are needed we will add PO_VERSION.
- Glyph can evaluate the 1.0% @15 proposal under the EPP pilot; procurement will review and confirm a final rate by Apr 27.
- We will accept consolidated monthly invoices. Procurement asked for a sample invoice in your proposed layout (please send).

I will upload our completed PO template and vendor setup checklist to the secure drive by Monday; once we receive your obfuscated sample invoice and vendor banking info we will prioritize the vendor setup so payments can follow the May 1 cutover.

Best,
Elena
